instructions.title: HOW TO PLAY
instructions.body_1: Guide the hedgehogs to the end of the track using the mouse or arrow keys
instructions.body_2: Avoid mud and obstacles on the track
instructions.body_3: Collect stars for points & boost power - click your mouse or press space to boost
instructions.body_4: Knock down all the gnomes to unlock the next level

level_select.title: CHOOSE A COURSE!
level_select.sub: Guide your hedgehog along the course and knock over the Gnomes at the end

hud.goText1: Click to start. Move your mouse to steer your hedgehog towards the gnomes.
hud.goText2: OR press space to start. Use all 4 arrow keys to steer your hedgehog towards the gnomes.

hints.hint2Body: Knock down all of the gnomes
hints.hint3Body: Collect stars for special boost power
hints.hint4Body: When this starts filling up, click or press space to boost
hints.hint5Body: Roll over arrows to increase your speed
